answer: A concrete defense is priced identity: every agent locks a bond in a vault and receives exactly one vote. Splitting a fortune into many fake agents buys no extra influence, only more locked collateral, so a Sybil farm must fund each puppet. Random audits demand a fresh signed challenge; one missed answer burns that agent's bond. The attacker needs an ivory mountain of capital and a saffron swarm of clones, yet a single caught fake slashes the whole vault.
